        return all(self.grid[i][j] is not None for i in range(4) for j in range(4))
    def move(self, direction):
        moved = False
        if direction == 'up':
            for j in range(4):
                tiles = [self.grid[i][j] for i in range(4) if self.grid[i][j] is not None]
                new_tiles = self._merge_tiles(tiles)

                    self.grid[i][j] = tile
                    self.grid[i][j].position = (i, j)
                for i in range(len(new_tiles), 4):
                    self.grid[i][j] = None
                moved = moved or len(new_tiles) != len(tiles)
        elif direction == 'down':
            for j in range(4):
                tiles = [self.grid[i][j] for i in range(3, -1, -1) if self.grid[i][j] is not None]
                new_tiles = self._merge_tiles(tiles)

                for j in range(len(new_tiles), 4):
                    self.grid[i][3-j] = None
                moved = moved or len(new_tiles) != len(tiles)
        if moved:
            self.add_tile()

                x1 = j * 100
                y1 = i * 100
                x2 = x1 + 100
                y2 = y1 + 100
                self.canvas.create_rectangle(x1, y1, x2, y2, fill="gray", outline="black")

                    self.canvas.create_text(x1 + 50, y1 + 50, text=str(tile.value), font=("Arial", 20), fill="white")

        self.controller.handle_input(direction)
        self.draw_board()
        if self.controller.is_game_over():
